hero.label: Cloud · AI · IaC
hero.title: Build cloud infrastructure that actually holds.
hero.subtitle: Dakina is a senior cloud and AI engineering consultancy. We work on what's hard: Azure architecture that survives production, IaC that teams maintain, AI agents that ship value beyond the demo.

valueProps.title: What sets us apart
valueProps.subtitle: Two principles shape how we deliver.

items.title: Senior expertise, end-to-end
items.description: No layered teams. No junior pass-through. The person scoping the work is the person doing it.

items.title: AI-native delivery
items.description: Claude and agentic tooling are part of how we generate IaC modules, review code, and produce documentation. It's how we work, not a service line.

items.title: France and MENA coverage
items.description: Active across France, Morocco, Saudi Arabia and the UAE. Arabic-speaking team. Business practices adapted to regional context on request.

items.title: Knowledge transfer by default
items.description: We don't build dependencies. Every engagement includes pair programming, documentation, and team enablement so you stay autonomous.

services.label: Our services
services.title: Services built around what production actually demands
services.subtitle: From strategy to operations, Dakina covers the full lifecycle of cloud, security, and AI transformation engagements.

items.title: Azure Architecture
items.shortDescription: Landing zones, Hub-Spoke networking, multi-subscription governance. Designs that survive 18 months of organic growth.

items.title: AI Engineering
items.shortDescription: Claude Code in the enterprise, AI gateways, agentic workflows, RAG pipelines. Production-grade AI, not demos.

items.title: IaC Industrialization

items.title: DevSecOps & CI/CD
items.shortDescription: Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions pipelines. Shift-left security, secret management, supply chain protection.

items.title: Cloud Security
items.shortDescription: Zero Trust architectures, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Entra ID hardening, NIS2 and ISO 27001 alignment.

items.title: Governance & FinOps
items.shortDescription: Azure Policy, RBAC at scale, tagging strategies, cost optimization. Governance that doesn't slow delivery down.
